name: Tank & Rast
aliases: Autobahn Tank & Rast Gruppe GmbH & Co. KG
subsector: motorway service areas and fuel stations
desc: Operator and franchisor of German autobahn service areas, fuel stations, truck stops, hotels and the largest motorway fast-charging network.
products: motorway restaurants (Serways), fuel stations, SANIFAIR toilets, ~50 hotels, 20+ truck stops (Autohöfe), EV charging (mblty)
customers: motorists, truck drivers, franchise partners, fuel brands
parent_immediate: Consortium: Allianz Capital Partners, OMERS Infrastructure, MEAG, China Investment Corporation
parent_ultimate: Consortium of infrastructure investors incl. CIC (Chinese sovereign fund) and OMERS (Canadian pension)
pe_swf_owner: China Investment Corporation; OMERS Infrastructure (consortium since 2015)
stores_or_sites: over 400 service areas (Raststätten), around 50 hotels, over 20 truck stops
markets: Germany: national network along the autobahns

alt_indicators.evidence: over 400 Raststätten, ~50 hotels, 20+ Autohöfe along German autobahns
leading service provider along German autobahns; operates the largest long-distance fast-charging network on the autobahn; over EUR 2bn invested since 1998

signals.what: mblty (Tank & Rast e-mobility unit) opened two electric truck charging parks at Lehrte (A2) and Dorfmark (A7)
SANIFAIR opened a facility in Aquis Plaza Aachen, extending the brand beyond motorways

fit_rationale: Germany's motorway forecourt and restaurant network reaches millions of drivers; F1 promotions at 400 service areas and its EV-charging push suit car-culture consumer activation, though Germany has no Grand Prix.
f1_markets: Germany has no current Grand Prix; neighbouring Austria, Belgium, Netherlands, Hungary

access.roles: CEO (Peter Markus Löw); Chief Administrative Officer / Director Corporate Communications

outstanding: Revenue and employee figures not published on pages opened; sponsorship history not checked.
